description: Find LinkedIn companies by keywords, with optional location, industry and company-size filters. Get company names, URLs, industries, location and search summaries as JSON. Use the returned URLs with company enrichment for further research. No employee search is performed. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of companies wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: linkedin-company-search
title: Discover LinkedIn companies
